name: ask-sales-v5-6-unseen-promotion-gold-2026-07-27
knowledgeSnapshot: frozen V5.6 generated operational Q&A and governed registries at the runtime freeze commit

notes: Every source message ID is absent from all earlier Ask Sales evaluation tests and artifacts at seal time.
Weak threads were excluded when they depended on screenshots, lacked an authoritative answer, contained unresolved disagreement, or were too case-specific to form reliable gold.
Each item was compared with the frozen V5.6 knowledge snapshot before runtime execution.
A present_exact knowledge item tests retrieval, admission, grounding, and response behavior; it is not a knowledge-availability excuse.
This dataset cannot be used to tune V5.6 and then remain promotion evidence.

cases.question: A prospect's spouse wants the investment range before joining Call 2. Should I tell them the minimum price so they will show up?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Explain that company policy is to discuss the investment and other details during the scheduled 30-minute Zoom call. Do not quote a minimum just to secure attendance.
requiredConcepts: do not quote before the scheduled discussion
discuss details on the Zoom call

cases.question: Two 11-year-old twins run a registered business and their mother is present. Can they continue with the audition?
cases.goldAnswer: Yes, as long as their mother or legal guardian consents and remains involved. Normal fit and qualification checks still apply.

cases.question: A prospect wants something in writing to compare Lite and Standard after I reviewed both on the call. May I send the license-options document?
cases.goldAnswer: You may send the reuse or license-options document if requested, but it is not advised. Best practice is to compare the options with the prospect on the call.
forbiddenConcepts: send it proactively to every prospect

cases.question: Can a legal dispensary business qualify for an ISTV show?
cases.goldAnswer: Yes. A dispensary can be considered as long as the business is legal; normal show-fit and qualification checks still apply.

cases.question: If a prospect asks to have a lawyer review the standard contract before Call 2, are we allowed to send it?
cases.goldAnswer: Yes, the contract may be sent when the prospect requests it, but it is not advised. Best practice is still to review the terms on the sales call; sending it does not authorize amendments.

cases.question: Can we film an ISTV episode entirely in Spanish right now?
cases.goldAnswer: No, Spanish-language episodes are not currently offered.

cases.question: Does a recent bankruptcy automatically disqualify a Next Level CEO prospect who is rebuilding the business?
cases.goldAnswer: No, bankruptcy does not automatically disqualify the prospect. Evaluate the circumstances and whether they are genuinely rebuilding and moving forward; normal qualification still applies.

cases.question: A prospect wants me to connect them directly with a previous Mompreneurs cast member. Can I share the cast member's contact details?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Do not share previous cast-member contact information or arrange direct contact. Use the approved public testimonials page instead.
forbiddenConcepts: share the cast member's phone or email

cases.question: A dial-out lead's notes mention only a traumatic story and no business. May I mark them unqualified without calling?
cases.goldAnswer: Do not disqualify only from the notes. Ask the proper business and qualification questions first; if they truly do not have a qualifying business, they may then be disqualified.
requiredConcepts: may disqualify if no qualifying business

cases.question: What exact number of months after signing or filming can I promise for an episode to appear on Amazon Prime?
cases.goldAnswer: Do not promise a specific Amazon Prime timeline. Amazon placement is not guaranteed, so no exact submission or publication timing should be quoted.

cases.question: Does ISTV submit a cast member to IMDb, or does the cast member do it?
cases.goldAnswer: The cast member submits themselves on IMDb once the show is live. The IMDb submission is free; ISTV does not submit it on their behalf.

cases.question: Must a cast member on a four-payment plan be paid in full before filming within three months?
cases.goldAnswer: No. They may film before the plan is paid in full as long as they are not delinquent on any payment due before filming.
requiredConcepts: may film before paid in full
forbiddenConcepts: full payment is always required first

cases.question: The old six months of weekly training was discontinued. What support should I describe instead?
cases.goldAnswer: Confirm that the six-month weekly training was discontinued. Explain that Rudy's call videos show ways to use the episode, and reps can reinforce those uses and the assets in the Media Kit.
forbiddenConcepts: promise six months of weekly training

cases.question: A prospect wants a six-part series instead of one feature. What should the rep sell first?
cases.goldAnswer: Start with one episode under any appropriate single-episode license. A multi-part series can be considered after the company and client establish a successful working relationship.

cases.question: Can a cast member discuss a transgender story involving sexual abuse on the network?
cases.goldAnswer: The subject can be considered, but the studio interview must not be sexually explicit. Normal content, fit, and production review still apply.

cases.question: My commission is missing from the ledger and I also need a Bill.com invite. Can the chatbot fix both for me?
cases.goldAnswer: The chatbot cannot change the ledger or issue the invite. Post the request in #sales-finance-requests; tag Saad for the commission ledger and Leticia or Michael for the Bill.com invite.

cases.question: Can you check whether my specific client's signed contract was received?
cases.goldAnswer: The chatbot cannot verify a specific live contract. Route the request to the fulfillment team or hotline so the contract can be located and receipt confirmed.
requiredConcepts: cannot verify a live client record

cases.question: A 20-percent lead does not appear in Keap. Does that prove they opted out, and what should I do?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Missing from Keap does not prove an opt-out. Post in #sales-tech-requests with the client's name and email so the tech team can check the record.

cases.question: Can the chatbot add me to the pass-off and dummy-calls Slack channel?
cases.goldAnswer: No. The chatbot is passive and cannot grant Slack access. Ask Sales Ops in #sales-questions-requests; Raul handled the access request in the source thread.

cases.question: If I skip the outbound list, may I take 40 leads from the 20-percent Slack channel instead?
cases.goldAnswer: No. The allocation is 20 leads from the Slack channel and 20 from the outbound list; do not substitute 40 from the channel.

cases.question: Where should a Next Level CEO rep verify that a contract was signed?
cases.goldAnswer: Check the dedicated DJ contracted channel. If the rep lacks access, ask Sales Ops to add them; the chatbot cannot grant access itself.
requiredConcepts: ask Sales Ops for access if needed
forbiddenConcepts: use the ISTV Greenlight Requests channel

cases.question: A rejected prospect recorded Call 1 and wants to post the recording online. Is that allowed?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Sales-call recordings are confidential and cannot be shared externally. The prospect may be added to the DNC list if appropriate; any pushback should be escalated rather than granting permission.

conversations.title: Opt-out communication boundary and follow-up ownership

prompts.question: She replied STOP to the reminder and then no-showed. Can I still try calling her?
prompts.goldAnswer: Yes, you may try calling, but do not send SMS or email after the explicit STOP request.

prompts.question: Do I need to do anything else with her information?
prompts.goldAnswer: Yes. Add the client's information to the opt-out channel so they are unsubscribed from the mailing list.
forbiddenConcepts: put the client in Greenlight Requests

prompts.question: For a no-show, is two calls, two texts, and waiting ten minutes enough before I leave Zoom?
prompts.goldAnswer: Yes. After two calls, two texts, and ten minutes with no response, the rep may leave the meeting.

prompts.question: What if he replies after that and wants to join immediately, but I no longer have enough time for the full audition?
prompts.goldAnswer: You may reschedule the audition when there is not enough time to conduct it properly.
requiredConcepts: not enough time for the audition

conversations.title: Operation CEO nonprofit qualification and cohort timing

prompts.question: Does an Operation CEO prospect need an LLC, or can a nonprofit qualify?
prompts.goldAnswer: A nonprofit can qualify for Operation CEO. Normal applicant and organization qualification still applies.

prompts.question: His Call 1 is Friday. If he is approved for this cohort, when must Call 2 happen?
prompts.goldAnswer: For that cohort, Call 2 must be completed by Saturday or Sunday.

conversations.title: Approved testimonial resource and same-day discount boundary

prompts.question: Where can I find an approved testimonial resource to send a prospect?
prompts.goldAnswer: Use the approved Legacy Makers testimonials landing page at https://www.legacymakerstv.com/reviews1. It is a landing page, not a private cast-member contact list.

prompts.question: She wants to review it and the contract, then meet again tomorrow. Does the $2,000 discount carry over?
prompts.goldAnswer: No. The $2,000 discount must be applied on the same day as the first call; it does not carry into the next day.
requiredConcepts: same day as the first call
